mapper.sql: id, user_id, product_id, quantity, checked, create_time, update_time
mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.product_id, p.name AS product_name, p.main_image, p.price, p.stock, c.quantity, c.checked FROM cart_item c JOIN product p ON c.product_id = p.id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY c.id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cart_item (user_id, product_id, quantity, checked) VALUES (#{userId}, #{productId}, #{quantity}, #{checked})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM cart_item WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
